verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a note-taking app, but nothing in the pack documents a first-party Obsidian AI feature that answers questions, summarizes, or drafts from notes, or any controls over what data it sees. Community reports point instead to third-party plugins (Text-Generator, Copilot) and say there is 'no decent RAG functionality'. Third-party plugins are ecosystem workarounds, not the product's own built-in capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a built-in AI assistant can answer questions, summarize, and draft grounded in my own notes — with clear controls over what data it sees
